description: This file defines the DashboardController class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for the Dashboard plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and manages the rendering of the dashboard view, including setting up the view component and permissions based on user roles.

classes.name: DashboardController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling dashboard-related view rendering and permission setup within the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and permissions before rendering the dashboard view, including setting the view component and permission data.
